scientific_scope: Internal Poissonnier 2026 open-arena painted-trail response development estimation for the frozen P3-v1 local-sector Weber/relative bilateral transduction mechanism only. This authorization permits one frozen high-resolution P3 response search only after this exact authorization is merged to main and permanent main test/deploy is green on a commit containing the pinned policy, estimator/core, qualification report, and qualification freeze. It is not external validation, canonical locomotion promotion, P1 or P2 rescue/rerun, H2-H5 recombination, or Y-maze validation.

authorized_frozen_execution.absolute_transduction_benchmark_rule: For each P3 Halton index 1..999, reuse the exact same sigma_field_mm and kappa_trail_per_s coordinates but replace only the painted-trail response mechanism with the frozen P1 absolute bilateral C/(1+C) transduction and sensor geometry. Add the same exact canonical null as index 1000. Rank the P3 and absolute-transduction panels separately on the same primary objective. This is a structural comparator, not a P1 rerun, and P1 official result semantics remain inaccessible.
authorized_frozen_execution.primary_objective: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the four squared pheromone-minus-DCM treatment-contrast errors: two primary observables x short/long path strata, with equal colony weighting.
authorized_frozen_execution.secondary_guard_rule: Post-selection only. On the independent final-check panel, absolute standardized P3 contrast error must be <= 1.0 for each of the four path x secondary-metric components using frozen n-1 sample-SD scaling.
authorized_frozen_execution.canonical_null_survival_guard: Selected P3 candidate must beat exact canonical null in at least 5 of 6 held-out LOCO folds and have strictly positive median relative held-out improvement versus exact null.
authorized_frozen_execution.structural_increment_survival_guard: Selected P3 candidate must beat the separately selected frozen absolute-transduction benchmark in at least 5 of 6 held-out LOCO folds and have strictly positive median relative held-out improvement versus that benchmark.
authorized_frozen_execution.dual_survival_rule: Both heldout survival guards must pass. Failure of either closes P3-v1 response estimation without retuning.
authorized_frozen_execution.identifiability_rule: If dual survival passes: exact null must be outside the P3 near-best set; best all-data absolute-transduction benchmark must lie outside the same P3 near-best tolerance; selected normalized sigma and kappa coordinates must each be at least 0.02 from an active bound; near-best normalized span must be <= 0.60 for each parameter.
authorized_frozen_execution.final_increment_rule: On the independent final-check panel, selected P3 primary loss must be strictly lower than both selected absolute-transduction benchmark primary loss and exact canonical-null primary loss.
authorized_frozen_execution.final_fit_rule: The all-102-row fit may occur only if both LOCO survival guards pass. It must reuse the same frozen candidate panels. The independent final-check panel may evaluate frozen promotion guards but may not trigger refitting, alternate candidates, changed bounds, or changed seeds.

execution_firewall: Do not change sigma or kappa bounds/scales, Halton mapping, candidate counts, absolute-transduction comparator construction, trial counts, seeds, physics dt, objective construction, colony weighting, fold membership, secondary guards, identifiability thresholds, or promotion thresholds.
Do not add nuisance parameters or refit baseline locomotion, H2, H3, H4, or H5.

Do not use P3 sensor-sector diagnostics, raw L/R sector means, Weber signal, steering omega, moving speed, moving distance, straightness, moving-time fraction, raw headings, or any forbidden observable for candidate ranking.
Do not pool pheromone-minus-DCM contrasts across path strata or weight colonies by ant-row count.
Do not introduce treatment-specific, path-specific, colony-specific, direction-specific, experience-specific, fold-specific, or threshold-specific response parameters.
Do not access, parse, or use P1 official response-estimation result semantics for tuning, selection, ranking, or interpretation of the P3 search.

Do not access, parse, or use P2 official response-estimation result semantics, P2 lapse structure, P2 engagement assignments, or P2 response RNG for tuning, selection, ranking, or interpretation of the P3 search.
Use src/p1.js only as the pinned frozen structural absolute-transduction comparator at the exact P3 sigma/kappa coordinates under the P3 objective.
Do not access or use Y-maze data, outcomes, simulations, geometry, labels, or metrics for selection, fitting, ranking, or interpretation.
Do not change the frozen P3 mechanism, runtime, model structure, sector sensor geometry, zero-epsilon Weber transduction, apparatus, canonical runtime, or canonical locomotion model.
Do not run an adaptive second-stage search, inject candidates, alter bounds, increase the budget, change seeds, or rerun with favorable seeds after seeing target-ranked outcomes.
Do not pass --candidates, --trials, --eval-trials, --seed, --final-trials, --final-seed, or --dt in high-resolution mode.
official_execution_rule: Authorize exactly one official execution of the frozen high-resolution P3-v1 response-estimation procedure after this authorization is merged and effective on main and the permanent main test/deploy workflow succeeds on a main commit containing this exact authorization, estimator blob 5bf27bf439dca18629cdfd36f56fe767a23062ff, estimator-core blob 410ef81dfe761e3c218d072ca311632329ac1617, policy blob d86eb9936e993d188f2a28faab838ba158c40f3b, qualification-report blob 63e1d7360bc1ef4b232bbf37f347b9fa27e7d461, and qualification-freeze blob 32d90d05add5b4e45dd69c711b416ed3378d15ab. A rerun is permitted only if the first official execution is formally declared invalid because of a genuine implementation or infrastructure error before a valid scientific result is produced; the entire frozen procedure must then be rerun unchanged.
post_result_rule: Freeze and record the complete P3 result before any interpretation-driven code, policy, mechanism, or model change. Failure cannot be rescued by retuning P3-v1, changing the search, changing the absolute-transduction comparator, weakening either survival guard, or selecting a favorable rerun. If either dual survival guard fails, close P3-v1 response estimation. If dual survival passes but identifiability, final increment, or secondary guards fail, report the appropriate limited conclusion without promoting a fixed parameter pair.
response_target_semantic_access_scope: Only through tools/run-p3-estimation.js in frozen highres mode after this exact authorization is effective on main and the separate execution precondition gate verifies green permanent main CI.
P1_runtime_structural_comparator_scope: Only the pinned src/p1.js frozen absolute-transduction mechanism under the P3 estimator's separately ranked comparator panel.
